description: This class 'ContentFiles' is a Java bean used in a web application for uploading and managing content files associated with merchants in the admin interface. It acts as a form data wrapper for handling uploaded multipart files and their metadata, including validation annotations.

classes.name: ContentFiles
classes.description: A Java bean that encapsulates uploaded content files and related metadata for merchant content management.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Setter for the list of uploaded multipart files.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Getter for the list of uploaded multipart files; includes validation annotations.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Setter for the file name associated with these content files.
